leadText: Kate Bristol is a voice actress for the English-language dub of .
plainText:
Kate Bristol is a voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Bristol got her first role, Kisa Sohma, at the age of eleven, and has provided voices for FUNimation ever since. In 2010, she played Dorothy in the NETworks North American tour of The Wizard of Oz. Her hobbies include reading, knitting, and playing games.

Bristol joined in the beginning of . Her most prominent roles are Valerie and Nurse Joy, having replaced Jennifer Forziati-DaCosta for the latter role. In , she gained the role of Sophocles's Togedemaru. Bristol left the midway through Sun & Moon, returning to Texas after having a baby. She does, notably, still provide voice work for Pokémon related media as she provides the voice for the female Pokémon Trainer in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. Bristol is currently affiliated with Mary Collins Agency.
